relations.subject: Bapu Deva Sastri
relations.evidence: Ab 1842 lehrte er Mathematik und Astronomie an der Government Sanskrit School in Varanasi (Benares). 1889 ging er in den Ruhestand

relations.subject: Sudhakara Dvivedi
